description: Real attributed quotes on habits, growth, and discipline.

quotes.text: Read what you love until you love to read.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: Specific knowledge is found by pursuing your genuine curiosity, not whatever is hot right now.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: Play long-term games with long-term people.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: A person's success in life can usually be measured by the number of uncomfortable conversations he or she is willing to have.
quotes.author: Tim Ferriss

quotes.text: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Every action is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: You should be far more concerned with your current trajectory than with your current results.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Clarity about what matters provides clarity about what does not.
quotes.author: Cal Newport

quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quotes.author: Will Durant

quotes.text: The main thing is to keep the main thing the main thing.
quotes.author: Stephen Covey

quotes.text: Spend each day trying to be a little wiser than you were when you woke up.
quotes.author: Charlie Munger

quotes.text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.text: Don't wait around for someone else to do it. Do it yourself.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: You will never learn from people if you always tap dance around the truth.
quotes.author: David Goggins

quotes.text: Believe you can and you are halfway there.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.text: If you don't like something, change it. If you can't change it, change your attitude.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.text: What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.text: The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.text: The only journey is the one within.
quotes.author: Rainer Maria Rilke

quotes.text: Action is the foundational key to all success.
quotes.author: Pablo Picasso

quotes.text: Discipline equals freedom.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.text: Good. When things are going bad, there's always going to be good that comes from it.
quotes.author: Jocko Willink

quotes.text: The path is made by walking.
quotes.author: Antonio Machado

quotes.text: What we fear doing most is usually what we most need to do.
quotes.author: Tim Ferriss
